item.title: Valorant Launches New "Toxic" Cinematic To Kick Off 2026
item.description: Check out the latest cinematic music video for Valorant, as they put a new spin on the song Toxic to hype up the year of content to come

item.title: Eat Your Young #5 Preview: Bloodbath and Daddy Issues Collide
item.description: Eat Your Young #5 hits stores Wednesday. Edmund Irons faces his son in a violent reckoning while Elsa remains missing. Blood will flow in Brooklyn.

item.title: The Rip: The Police Are Corrupt As Hell In The Official Trailer
item.description: Netflix has released the official trailer for The Rip, the new film from director Joe Carnahan, which will be released on January 16th.

item.title: They Will Kill You: First Trailer Is Giving Big Ready Or Not Vibes
item.description: Warner Bros. has released the first trailer for the next horror film, They Will Kill You, which will be released on March 27th.

item.title: Supergirl: New Piece Of International Promo Art
item.description: A new piece of international promo art for Supergirl has been released. The next big screen entry in the DC Universe will be released on June 26, 2026.

item.title: Avatar Crosses $1 Billion, The Housemaid Strong At Weekend Box Office
item.description: While Disney's Avatar: Fire and Ash and Zootopia 2 continue to dominate the box office, The Housemaid is stealing the headlines.

item.title: War Wolf #3 Preview: Hero or Zero? Bruin's Big Secret
item.description: War Wolf #3 hits stores this Wednesday! Can Thomas Bruin keep his heroic facade intact, or will the truth destroy everything he's built?

item.title: The Phantom #4 Preview: Outnumbered But Not Out-Phantomed
item.description: The Phantom #4 hits stores this Wednesday! Can the Ghost Who Walks survive when the Singh Brotherhood puts that old jungle saying to the test?
